items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I had Joe Avery on the trombone.

ctx.x: Well, who did you have in the young tuxedo when you first organized it?

First I could play with him. Mm-hmm. I had a, a platonic called Page on the studio for him. And Albert Jackson on the trombone. Mm-hmm. I had Joe Avery on the trombone. Mm-hmm. And my cousin was alto sax timbres. Mm-hmm. I had a little Jim on the bass drum. I was using a Latinx's piece. Oh, my kid, I used no smear, you know. Oh, my kid, he's very terrific. I like to have a young tuxedo thing. That's right. Right. Right. And then they had the two lads. Yeah. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right.…
Didn't have a baritone or an offer?
